model_annotations.Bulgarian:
Фигурата илюстрира промените в максималната стойност на активацията за различни компоненти на модел (baseline) в зависимост от слоя. Заглавието на графиката е „Massive Activation of baseline".

Оста X е обозначена като „Layer" и използва линейна скала с диапазон от 0 до приблизително 23, като етикетите са разположени през интервали от 5 единици (0, 5, 10, 15, 20). Оста Y е обозначена като „Max Activation Value" и също използва линейна скала с диапазон от 0 до 1600, като етикетите са разположени през интервали от 200 единици.

Първата линия, „attn_output", е синя, пунктирана с тирета и маркери. Тя остава близо до 0 от слой 0 до приблизително слой 20, след което рязко нараства, достигайки стойност около 600 при слой 23.

Втората линия, „attn_residual", е оранжева и пунктирана с точки. Тя остава близо до 0 до приблизително слой 4–5, след което рязко нараства до около 1400 при слой 6. Линията продължава да се покачва леко, достигайки приблизително 1500 около слой 10–15, и остава на това ниво до около слой 20, след което рязко спада до стойност около 400 при слой 23.

Третата линия, „ffn_output", е зелена, пунктирана с тире-точка. Тя остава близо до 0 от слой 0 до около слой 4, след което рязко нараства до приблизително 1400 при слой 5. Веднага след това тя спада обратно близо до 0 около слой 7–8 и остава ниска до приблизително слой 13, където отново рязко нараства до около 500 при слой 14, след което отново спада до близо 0 около слой 16 и остава ниска до края.

Четвъртата линия, „ffn_residual", е червена и плътна. Тя остава близо до 0 от слой 0 до приблизително слой 4–5, след което рязко нараства до около 1500 при слой 6. Линията се задържа на приблизително 1500–1570 от слой 6 до около слой 20, като достига видим връх около 1570 в участъка между слоеве 14 и 20. След слой 20 тя рязко спада до приблизително 400 при слой 23.
model_annotations.Chinese: This figure, titled "Massive Activation of baseline," displays the maximum activation value across different layers of a model for four distinct components. The x-axis is labeled "Layer" with a linear scale ranging from 0 to approximately 23, with major tick intervals of 5. The y-axis is labeled "Max Activation Value" with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 1600, with major tick intervals of 200. The first line, "attn_output," is shown in blue with a dash-dot line style and no visible markers; it remains near 0 from layer 0 through approximately layer 20, then rises sharply to around 600 by layer 23. The second line, "attn_residual," is depicted in orange with a dotted line style; it stays near 0 from layer 0 to around layer 5, then climbs steeply to approximately 1400 at layer 6, continues rising to roughly 1500 by layer 8, remains relatively flat around 1500 through layer 20, and then drops sharply to approximately 400 near layer 22 before rising slightly toward layer 23. The third line, "ffn_output," is shown in green with a dash-dot line style; it remains near 0 from layer 0 to about layer 4, spikes sharply to approximately 1400 at layer 5, then drops back down to near 0 around layer 7, stays near 0 until about layer 13, rises to roughly 400–500 around layer 14, drops back to near 0 around layer 16, and remains near 0 through layer 23. The fourth line, "ffn_residual," is drawn in red with a solid line style; it stays near 0 from layer 0 to approximately layer 5, rises steeply to about 1500 around layer 6, plateaus near 1500–1570 from roughly layer 7 through layer 20, then drops sharply to approximately 400 near layer 22 before rising slightly toward layer 23.
model_annotations.English:
This plot illustrates the massive activation values of a baseline model across different layers, showing the maximum activation value for four different components of a transformer architecture. The x-axis represents "Layer," displayed on a linear scale ranging from 0 to approximately 23, with tick marks at intervals of 5. The y-axis represents "Max Activation Value," also on a linear scale, ranging from 0 to 1600, with tick marks at intervals of 200.

The blue dashed line with no visible markers represents "attn_output," which remains near 0 from layer 0 through approximately layer 20, then rises sharply to roughly 600 by layer 23. The orange dotted line represents "attn_residual," which stays near 0 until around layer 5, where it rises steeply to approximately 1400, then continues to increase gradually to around 1500–1550 through layers 7–20, before dropping sharply back toward approximately 400 at layer 23. The green dash-dot line represents "ffn_output," which remains near 0 from layer 0 to about layer 4, spikes sharply to approximately 1400 at layer 5, then drops back down to near 0 around layer 7, rises again to roughly 400–500 between layers 13 and 15, returns to near 0 from layers 16–20, and then increases steeply to approximately 600 at layer 23. The red solid line represents "ffn_residual," which stays near 0 from layer 0 to approximately layer 5, rises steeply to about 1500 around layer 6, remains relatively flat at approximately 1500–1570 through layer 20, and then drops sharply to approximately 400 by layer 23.
model_annotations.German: Dieses Diagramm trägt den Titel „Massive Activation of baseline" und zeigt den maximalen Aktivierungswert über verschiedene Schichten eines Modells für vier verschiedene Komponenten. Die x-Achse ist mit „Layer" beschriftet, verwendet eine lineare Skala und erstreckt sich von 0 bis etwa 23, mit Tick-Beschriftungen in regelmäßigen Intervallen von 5 (0, 5, 10, 15, 20). Die y-Achse ist mit „Max Activation Value" beschriftet, verwendet ebenfalls eine lineare Skala und reicht von 0 bis 1600, mit Tick-Beschriftungen in Intervallen von 200. Es werden vier Linien dargestellt: Die Linie „attn_output" ist blau, gestrichelt mit Strich-Punkt-Muster und verläuft von Layer 0 bis etwa Layer 20 nahe bei 0, steigt dann ab Layer 21 steil an und erreicht bei Layer 23 einen Wert von etwa 600. Die Linie „attn_residual" ist orange und gepunktet; sie bleibt bis etwa Layer 5 nahe 0, steigt dann steil auf etwa 1400 bei Layer 6 an, verläuft danach relativ konstant bei etwa 1500 bis Layer 20 und fällt anschließend steil auf etwa 400 bei Layer 23 ab. Die Linie „ffn_output" ist grün mit Strich-Punkt-Muster; sie bleibt bis Layer 4 nahe 0, steigt bei Layer 5 steil auf etwa 1400 an, fällt dann bei Layer 6 wieder auf nahe 0 ab, zeigt bei Layer 13 einen erneuten Anstieg auf etwa 500, fällt bei Layer 15 wieder auf nahe 0 und steigt ab Layer 21 erneut auf etwa 600 bei Layer 23. Die Linie „ffn_residual" ist rot und durchgezogen; sie verläuft bis Layer 4 nahe 0, steigt bei Layer 5 steil auf etwa 1400 an, erreicht bei etwa Layer 7 einen Wert von ungefähr 1520 und verbleibt auf einem Plateau von etwa 1540–1560 bis Layer 20, bevor sie ab Layer 21 steil auf etwa 400 bei Layer 23 abfällt.
